summary: this plugin registers an mcp server named rea through .mcp.json, launched with npx -y rea-agents@6.5.0 mcp. the package is fetched from npm on first run and executed, and its code was not shown for review. the manifest and readme describe the server, but the plugin ships a capability-granting .mcp.json and runs unreviewed network-fetched code.

warnings.detail: the mcp server command runs `npx -y rea-agents@6.5.0 mcp`, which downloads an npm package and executes it automatically; its code is not in the reviewed folder and can change after review.
the plugin ships an .mcp.json that registers an mcp server (rea) with a launch command, which grants the agent new tool capability when the plugin is enabled.
the mcp config launches a process via npx with the -y flag, so no confirmation is asked before the package is installed and run.
npx fetches the rea-agents package from the npm registry (registry.npmjs.org) on first call, as the readme confirms.

override.reason: known upstream tool morluto/rea (MIT), distributed under external/ not authored by us; rea launches rea-agents via npx by design and the install consent sheet shows the full npx -y rea-agents@6.5.0 mcp command before enabling; residual risk (payload fetched from npm at runtime, version-pinned not hash-pinned) accepted by the owner 2026-10-16
